title: serve
summary: Starts the MCP (Model Context Protocol) stdio server, for AI clients such as Claude or Cursor to query a drag-lint index
intro: Read this when you want an AI assistant such as Claude or Cursor to query a drag-lint index: serve starts an MCP stdio server over the database you give it. The IDE does not use it; the IDE uses lsp.

questions.ask: How do I let an AI client such as Claude or Cursor query the index?
